title: Oficial de inteligência
description:
US$ 1100 – 2800 por mês

Serviço oficial nas unidades militares das Forças Armadas da Ucrânia

Responsabilidades

  • Executar tarefas de inteligência
  • Coletar, analisar e transmitir informações de inteligência ao comando
  • Realizar tarefas de observação e monitoramento de território
  • Utilizar equipamentos modernos: drones, dispositivos de visão noturna, termovisores, etc.
  • Desenvolver habilidades de sobrevivência e atuar de forma autônoma quando necessário

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Boa resistência física
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em zona de guerra
  • Aptidão para o serviço militar por questões de saúde
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Experiência militar será um diferencial
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

title: Desenvolvedor Java/ Springboot - Sênior
description:
Pessoa desenvolvedora Backend Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Atuar com desenvolvimento de software usando principalmente a tecnologia Java/Springboot.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver, testar e manter APIs e serviços backend de alta qualidade e eficiência, utilizando Java e SpringBoot.
  • Colaborar com times de frontend e outros stakeholders para garantir que as entregas atendam aos requisitos de negócio e técnicos.
  • Documentar as soluções e práticas adotadas no desenvolvimento.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Java.
  • Conhecimento do framework SpringBoot e suas principais bibliotecas e módulos (Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring MVC, etc).
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados relacionais (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL) e noSQL (ex: MongoDB, Redis).
  • Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful.
  • Experiência com controle de versão, preferencialmente Git.



Você pode se destacar se:

  • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de CI/CD (ex: Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de microsserviços e em servidores de aplicação leve.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer

title: Manufacturing Support Engineers - MES Syncade
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Manufacturing Support Engineers - MES Syncade who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

  • Proficiency in Manufacturing Engineering MES, with a strong background in Syncade MES.
  • Deep understanding of the Life Sciences domain, specifically in regulated manufacturing environments.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle and validated system environments.
  • Experience working within Agile frameworks and sprint-based development processes.
  • Solid knowledge of database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle).
  • Hands-on experience in application architecture, design patterns, and development practices.
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in Manufacturing Engineering MES, specifically in life sciences or pharmaceutical industries, is required.
  • Candidates must have completed 15 years of full-time education.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform independently and progressively grow into a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for MES applications.
  • Serve as the first point of contact for shop-floor users; diagnose, resolve, and document issues for Syncade.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Quality, and IT to restore service quickly and minimize production impact
  • Propose and deliver practical solutions to business and technical problems.
  • Maintain and improve support knowledge (KB articles, SOPs) and provide targeted user coaching and quick tips to reduce repeat issues.
  • Monitor system health and alerts; identify patterns and propose corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) or continuous improvement suggestions. Conduct and participate in peer code reviews; provide constructive feedback to uphold development standards.
  • Remain current on application development trends, MES technologies, and industry best practices.

title: Junior SMM Manager
description:
We are looking for a Junior SMM Manager to support the growth of the SPLAT brand in Brazil.

This role is designed for someone with basic hands-on experience in social media who is ready to take ownership of content, actively engage with audiences, and grow quickly in a fast-paced international environment.

You will work closely with the team to build brand presence, test content ideas, and improve engagement in the local market.


What You Will Do

Content Creation (core focus):

  • Create and publish content across social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, TikTok, etc.)
  • Write captions and adapt content for the Brazilian audience
  • Use simple tools (Canva, CapCut, etc.) to produce content

Community Management:

  • Manage comments and direct messages
  • Engage with followers and maintain a consistent brand tone

Influencer Outreach (basic level):

  • Identify and research local micro-influencers
  • Support communication and collaboration processes

Growth & Insights:

  • Monitor trends and competitors
  • Suggest practical ideas to improve reach and engagement


Who We Are Looking For

  • Fluent in English (daily communication with an international team)
  • Native or fluent in Brazilian Portuguese
  • Based in Brazil (São Paulo preferred)
  • Has basic SMM experience (personal projects, freelance, or internships)
  • Understands how modern social media works
  • Can create simple content independently
  • Proactive, reliable, and comfortable with routine execution
  • Motivated to learn and grow in marketing


Application Requirements

  • Please include: links to social media accounts you have managed or examples of content you have created

Applications without examples may not be considered.


What We Offer

  • Hands-on SMM experience from day one
  • Clear tasks and real responsibility (no “theory-only” role)
  • International team and English-speaking environment
  • Fast growth for strong performers

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.


Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Key Responsibilities


  • Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
  • Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
  • Use AI tools (Nanobanana, Freepik AI, Magic Canva Studio) to generate engaging videos and simple animations for social media.
  • Editing videos and creating simple animations for social media use.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.
  • Work on design projects from start to finish, ensuring designs are on-brand, on-time, and meet all requirements.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
  • Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.


Qualifications


  • Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in design software like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere), Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft programs (PowerPoint and Word)
  • Experience working with video editing tools like Premiere, CapCut, and Canva.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, Claude, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.
  • Understanding of digital design principles for social media, websites, and other online platforms.
  • Understanding of small-scale and large-scale print materials (such as business cards, flyers, menus, conference collateral, merchandise, banners, backdrops, etc.)
  • Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
  • A working level of written and spoken English


Our operating hours are 9 A.M. to 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: .Net Software Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.


We are looking for a Backend Developer to join our team and support the development, maintenance, and evolution of services and APIs that power our digital applications and products. This role requires someone who is passionate about building scalable, secure, and high-performance backend solutions and collaborating within an agile environment.


A key part of this role will be validating the end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs in a controlled environment. The proof of concept will demonstrate deterministic orchestration, rule-based evaluation, integration with third-party APIs, and the generation of non-binding scenarios through an AI interface.

Fluent English is essential, as the role involves close collaboration with international stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and evolve backend services and APIs that support digital platforms and applications
  • Validate end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs
  • Contribute to proof-of-concept initiatives involving deterministic orchestration and rule-based evaluation
  • Integrate backend services with third-party APIs and external platforms
  • Build scalable and reliable backend systems following established best practices and architectural standards
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives
  • Implement unit tests and ensure quality through proper testing and integration practices
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including product, QA, and engineering


Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience in backend development
  • Proficiency in C#
  • Experience with SQL databases and relational database design
  • Experience with NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB
  • Knowledge of API development and integration
  • Experience writing and maintaining unit tests
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum
  • Fluent English (spoken and written)

This role requires someone who is passionate about building scalable, secure, and high-performance backend solutions and collaborating within an agile environment.


A key part of this role will be validating the end-to-end orchestration of automated automotive payment scenarios using external APIs in a controlled environment.   • Build scalable and reliable backend systems following established best practices and architectural standards
  • Collaborate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives
  • Implement unit tests and ensure quality through proper testing and integration practices
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams including product, QA, and engineering

  • Proficiency in C#

  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies, particularly Scrum

Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de Desenvolvimento Front-end com React, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, com foco em experiência do usuário, performance e inovação.

title: Ivanti ITSM Support
description:
We are looking for an Ivanti ITSM Specialist to take over the managed support and administration of an existing Ivanti environment. The main goal is to ensure platform stability, manage day-to-day operations, and support the ITSM application while parallel assessments are running.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Administration: Handle day-to-day configuration and maintenance of the Ivanti ITSM platform.
  • Queue Management: Manage incident and request queues, performing triage and ensuring timely resolution.
  • User Management: Administer users, groups, and maintain the service catalog.
  • Reporting: Generate and maintain dashboards and operational reports as needed.
  • Maintenance & Support: Provide minor enhancements and break-fix support to ensure \"nothing stops, nothing breaks.\"
  • Vendor Liaison: Act as the point of contact with Ivanti vendors for technical escalations.


Technical Requirements (Must-haves)

  • Experience: Proven experience administering Ivanti Service Management (ISM) or Ivanti Neurons for ITSM .
  • ITSM Knowledge: Strong understanding of IT Service Management processes (Incident, Request, Change management).
  • Reporting: Ability to run and customize reports within the Ivanti environment.
  • Soft Skills: Proactive \"keep the lights on\" mindset, ability to work independently, and clear communication.

title: Analista de dados
description:
Analista Qualidade de Software - PL/SR


Conhecimentos obrigatórios

  • Ambiente Cloud (AWS)
  • Contato prévio com AWS Glue, Athena e S3
  • Não é necessário domínio avançado, mas é importante já ter vivenciado ambientes em nuvem
  • Python para análise e manipulação de dados

Atuação focada na adaptação de template global para o Brasil, incluindo configuração, testes técnicos e suporte à homologação.

Desejável: experiência em rollout internacional, indústria automotiva, interfaces SAP x legados e inglês para interação global .

Experiência com SAP S/4HANA , conhecimento complementar em módulos como MM e FI , além de entendimento de SDLC . Necessário inglês para atuação com stakeholders internacionais.

Atuação em projeto de rollout com prazo determinado e possibilidade de prorrogação.

Requisitos: inglês avançado e disponibilidade para trabalho híbrido em São Bernardo do Campo – SP.

Atuação em implementação S/4HANA Greenfield + Implico , com domínio em IS-Oil (SDM, HPM, TSW) e logística Downstream.

title: Analista de testes sênior
description:
Curte garantir qualidade em sistemas que realmente fazem a operação acontecer?

Como Analista de QA, você será peça-chave na estabilidade e evolução de soluções ERP, assegurando que cada entrega funcione com precisão, performance e confiabilidade.


Aqui, qualidade não é só testar — é entender o negócio, antecipar riscos e garantir uma experiência sólida para o usuário final.


Responsabilidades

Planejar e executar testes funcionais e não funcionais em sistemas ERP

Criar e manter roteiros de testes (manuais e automatizados)

Desenvolver automações de testes utilizando Selenium

Validar integrações entre sistemas (APIs, serviços, etc.)

Executar consultas em banco de dados (SQL) para validação de dados

Identificar, documentar e acompanhar bugs até a resolução

Atuar próximo ao time de desenvolvimento e produto

Participar de refinamentos, garantindo critérios de aceite claros

Contribuir para melhoria contínua da qualidade e processos

✅ Requisitos obrigatórios

Experiência como QA/Testes em sistemas ERP ou sistemas complexos

Conhecimento sólido em testes funcionais e regressivos

Experiência com Selenium (automação de testes)

Conhecimento em SQL para validação de dados

Experiência com documentação de testes e gestão de bugs

Boa comunicação com times técnicos e de negócio

⭐ Diferenciais

Experiência com testes de APIs (Postman, Insomnia, etc.)

Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)

Conhecimento em CI/CD (pipeline de testes automatizados)

Experiência com testes em sistemas financeiros ou operacionais

Noções de performance e testes de carga

title: Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer (Full Stack, AI + Data Systems)
description:
Job Description

We’re a stealth startup backed by a repeat founder and top-tier investors.


We’re rebuilding the financial plumbing behind a trillion-dollar asset class — commercial real estate insurance — one of the largest, most archaic financial systems in the United States.


Today, this market still runs on manual workflows, fragmented data, and decades-old infrastructure.

Our top competitors represent over $300B in combined market value, and the core workflows in this industry have not been meaningfully disrupted in decades.


We’re building an AI-native platform that ingests fragmented insurance data across documents, APIs, and third-party systems, and transforms it into a unified, structured layer for underwriting and decision-making.


Incubated by a team that has already built two successful companies in this exact industry and ICP, we’re now assembling a world-class team to build the next one.


We are assembling the Avengers of financial services and insurance tech — a small, elite team of builders who want to define this category.


We’re looking for a Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer to ensure every data point we produce is correct, reliable, and production-ready.


This is not traditional QA. This is owning quality across AI systems, data pipelines, and critical financial infrastructure — where silent failures are unacceptable.


The Role

As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will:

- Own testing across the full stack — frontend, backend, and AI/ML outputs

- Build testing infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines from scratch

- Design regression frameworks to detect accuracy drift across model and prompt changes

- Validate complex data pipelines where correctness is non-negotiable

- Define and enforce quality standards across deterministic systems and AI/ML outputs

- Work directly with founders and engineers to ship quickly without compromising quality

- Set the bar for all future QA and engineering hires


What You’ll Own

- End-to-end validation of data and document processing systems from ingestion through structured output

- Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems

- API integration testing and validation of external data flows

- Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences

- CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack

- Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scale


Who Are You?

- You’ve tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing)

- Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- You’ve built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented

- Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others miss


Technical Skills

- Python (pytest or similar)

- Playwright or Cypress

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems


Bonus:

- Experience testing LLM or AI systems

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments


Culture & Expectations

This is an intense, output-driven environment.

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

High ownership. High accountability. High standards.

We don’t care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability.

We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.


Logistics

- Quarterly trips to NYC for collaboration


Compensation

Competitive salary

Meaningful equity

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person


Who This Is Ideal For

A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.


Why Join Now?

You’d be joining at the exact moment when:

- The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders

- Two successful companies have already been built in this domain

- The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned

- The market is at a breaking point and demanding change

- The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcome


If you’re hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren’t many chances to be this early on something this big.

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- You’ve built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented

- Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others miss


Technical Skills

- Python (pytest or similar)

- Playwright or Cypress

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems


Bonus:

- Experience testing LLM or AI systems

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments


Culture & Expectations

This is an intense, output-driven environment.

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

High ownership. High accountability. High standards.

We don’t care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability.

We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.


Logistics

- Quarterly trips to NYC for collaboration


Compensation

Competitive salary

Meaningful equity

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person


Who This Is Ideal For

A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.


Why Join Now?

You’d be joining at the exact moment when:

- The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders

- Two successful companies have already been built in this domain

- The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned

- The market is at a breaking point and demanding change

- The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcome


If you’re hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren’t many chances to be this early on something this big.

title: Engenheiro DevOps (inglês fluente)
description:
Principais Responsabilidades:


• Instalar, configurar, administrar e dar suporte a sistemas e serviços de Core Banking em diferentes ambientes (DEV/UAT/PROD).

• Automatizar atividades operacionais e de deploy utilizando Rundeck e Ansible (orquestração de jobs, playbooks/roles, inventários e gerenciamento seguro de credenciais).

• Criar e manter runbooks, procedimentos operacionais e documentação padrão para permitir execuções repetíveis e auditáveis.

• Fornecer suporte à produção e participar da resposta a incidentes, incluindo triagem, correção e análises pós-incidente (RCA/gestão de problemas).

• Monitorar a saúde e o desempenho dos sistemas; implementar melhorias proativas em disponibilidade, resiliência e capacidade.

• Gerenciar configuração, aplicação de patches e ciclo de vida de componentes de sistema operacional, middleware e aplicações, garantindo conformidade com controles internos.

• Coordenar o controle, renovação e implantação de certificados digitais (ex.: TLS/SSL), incluindo inventário, monitoramento de vencimento, planejamento de mudanças, validação e documentação para evitar interrupções de serviço.

• Trabalhar com equipes de aplicações, infraestrutura e fornecedores para solucionar problemas complexos de ponta a ponta e garantir resolução no prazo.

• Apoiar o gerenciamento de mudanças, planejando, testando, documentando e executando alterações com avaliação de riscos e aprovações adequadas.

• Contribuir para a melhoria de práticas de CI/CD e releases (controle de versão, gestão de artefatos, consistência de ambientes), quando aplicável.

• Aplicar boas práticas de segurança, incluindo hardening, controle de acesso, gestão de segredos e auditabilidade.


Requisitos:

• Mais de 5 anos em Instituições Financeiras; conhecimento do mercado financeiro brasileiro e de produtos/processos de core banking.

• Experiência prática em DevOps/automação com Rundeck e Ansible.

• Conhecimento em scripts (ex.: PowerShell, Bash, Python) para automação e ferramentas operacionais.

• Sólido conhecimento em Windows e Unix/Linux, incluindo troubleshooting, performance e aplicação de patches.

• Experiência com suporte a aplicações e middleware (ex.: servidores web/app, agendamento batch, transferência de arquivos).

• Experiência com ferramentas/tecnologias corporativas como SQL Server, Oracle, Control-M, MQ, ServiceNow, Splunk, Jira, Nexus, LDAP/AD.

• Conhecimento prático em gestão de certificados (inventário, planejamento de renovação/rotação, implantação e validação pós-mudança).

• Entendimento de conceitos de CI/CD e workflows baseados em Git / pipelines de deploy.

• Forte habilidade de comunicação com stakeholders; capacidade de trabalhar com fornecedores globais/locais e equipes internas.

• Inglês avançado.


Desejável:

• Experiência com SAFe; exposição ao GCP.

• Experiência com iniciativas de migração/modernização.

• Espanhol.

• Monitorar a saúde e o desempenho dos sistemas; implementar melhorias proativas em disponibilidade, resiliência e capacidade.

• Gerenciar configuração, aplicação de patches e ciclo de vida de componentes de sistema operacional, middleware e aplicações, garantindo conformidade com controles internos.

• Coordenar o controle, renovação e implantação de certificados digitais (ex.: TLS/SSL), incluindo inventário, monitoramento de vencimento, planejamento de mudanças, validação e documentação para evitar interrupções de serviço.

• Trabalhar com equipes de aplicações, infraestrutura e fornecedores para solucionar problemas complexos de ponta a ponta e garantir resolução no prazo.

• Apoiar o gerenciamento de mudanças, planejando, testando, documentando e executando alterações com avaliação de riscos e aprovações adequadas.

• Contribuir para a melhoria de práticas de CI/CD e releases (controle de versão, gestão de artefatos, consistência de ambientes), quando aplicável.

• Aplicar boas práticas de segurança, incluindo hardening, controle de acesso, gestão de segredos e auditabilidade.


Requisitos:

• Mais de 5 anos em Instituições Financeiras; conhecimento do mercado financeiro brasileiro e de produtos/processos de core banking.

• Experiência prática em DevOps/automação com Rundeck e Ansible.

• Conhecimento em scripts (ex.: PowerShell, Bash, Python) para automação e ferramentas operacionais.

• Sólido conhecimento em Windows e Unix/Linux, incluindo troubleshooting, performance e aplicação de patches.

• Experiência com suporte a aplicações e middleware (ex.: servidores web/app, agendamento batch, transferência de arquivos).

• Experiência com ferramentas/tecnologias corporativas como SQL Server, Oracle, Control-M, MQ, ServiceNow, Splunk, Jira, Nexus, LDAP/AD.

• Conhecimento prático em gestão de certificados (inventário, planejamento de renovação/rotação, implantação e validação pós-mudança).

• Entendimento de conceitos de CI/CD e workflows baseados em Git / pipelines de deploy.

• Forte habilidade de comunicação com stakeholders; capacidade de trabalhar com fornecedores globais/locais e equipes internas.

• Inglês avançado.


Desejável:

• Experiência com SAFe; exposição ao GCP.

• Experiência com iniciativas de migração/modernização.

• Espanhol.

title: IT Risk Management Lead
description:
IT Risk Management Lead


Comcentia is seeking an experienced IT Risk Management Lead to drive the design, build‑out, and continuous improvement of our client’s enterprise IT Risk Management Program. This role leads the development of risk intake processes, assessment methodologies, and quantitative models aligned with NIST‑based frameworks and the organization’s ISMS.


You’ll partner with Cybersecurity, IT, business stakeholders, and risk owners to identify, assess, document, and monitor technology risks across the enterprise. The Lead serves as the primary SME for IT risk, producing executive‑ready reporting, maturing risk metrics and dashboards, and ensuring treatment plans are well‑defined, tracked, and executed.


Key Responsibilities:

• Lead structured IT risk assessments and apply quantitative scoring models

• Enhance risk intake processes, assessment tools, and framework alignment

• Maintain the enterprise risk register and map risks to SCF‑aligned controls

• Drive treatment planning, cross‑functional coordination, and lifecycle tracking

• Deliver risk reporting, dashboards, and decision‑ready materials for leadership

• Support governance cycles, audit readiness, and GRC tooling adoption

• Champion automation and AI‑enabled workflows to improve program efficiency


Qualifications:

• 7+ years in IT Risk Management, ISMS, or Cybersecurity

• Strong English proficiency (TOEFL Score: 90+ ) required

• Experience leading enterprise risk programs—not just contributing to them

• Strong knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST CSF , SOC 2 , PCI, GDPR

• Hands‑on experience with GRC platforms and risk assessment methodologies

• Excellent communication skills for both technical and executive audiences

• Preferred certifications: ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CISA, CISSP, CISM, SCF Practitioner

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
This is mostly manual position. This role is fully remote and is a PJ contractor.


Required Skills & Experience


• 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (manual and/or blended QA roles) with strong ownership of test execution and release readiness.

• Jira proficiency for defect tracking, workflows, and reporting.

• Hands-on experience with API testing (e.g., Postman, Swagger, curl, or similar) — note: API work is a smaller portion (~10%).

• Cruise / travel / hotel / hospitality industry experience

• Strong understanding of QA fundamentals: test design, defect lifecycle, SDLC/STLC, and Agile testing practices. Excellent communication skills and ability to partner cross-functionally.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Experience testing eCommerce, booking engines, reservations, loyalty, payments, check-in/boarding, or guest service platforms.

• Exposure to test automation (any framework/tool) and ability to collaborate with automation engineers (if applicable).

• Basic SQL for validation, data checks, or troubleshooting. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and release processes.


Job Description


We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of customer-facing and internal applications in a fast-paced travel/hospitality environment. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams to define test strategy, execute testing across releases, and continuously improve QA processes. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on QA experience, deep familiarity with Jira, and working knowledge of API testing (a smaller portion of the overall workload).


Day to Day

• Own and execute end-to-end testing for web and/or mobile applications, including functional, regression, smoke, and UAT support.

• Create and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and test execution evidence aligned to release timelines.

• Work in Agile/Scrum teams to provide early QA input on requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.

• Log, track, and manage defects in Jira, ensuring high-quality documentation and strong follow-through through resolution.

• Perform API validation/testing (estimated ~10% of overall effort) using tools such as Postman/Swagger or similar; validate request/response payloads and integration behaviors.

• Collaborate with engineers and product owners to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and confirm release readiness.

• Help improve QA efficiency through better test coverage, risk-based testing, and repeatable regression approaches. Contribute to quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement across the SDLC.

title: [Tech] Engenharia de Software Backend Pleno - Java
description:
Descrição da vaga

Atuar em equipe ágil no desenvolvimento e sustentação de produtos digitais, entregando valor de forma contínua e com qualidade, utilizando boas práticas de engenharia de software, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a estabilidade das soluções em produção.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, colaborando para manter um ambiente saudável e produtivo entre os membros da equipe;
  • Desenvolver e evoluir os produtos com foco em qualidade, utilizando testes automatizados e realizando revisões de código entre pares (code review);
  • Corrigir eventuais problemas nos sistemas com base na priorização definida pelo Product Owner, assegurando a satisfação dos clientes e usuários;
  • Realizar deploy em ambiente de produção utilizando processos de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD), garantindo a estabilidade da aplicação;
  • Propor melhorias técnicas e participar ativamente da evolução da arquitetura dos sistemas;
  • Garantir a segurança e a qualidade das entregas, respeitando os padrões estabelecidos pela equipe;
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas parceiras (DevOps, QA, Produto) na busca por soluções robustas e escaláveis.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo ou cursando na área de Tecnologia da Informação;
  • Programação orientada a objetos (POO);
  • Linguagem Java (preferencialmente versão 8 ou superior);
  • Spring Framework (Core, Boot, Data, etc.);
  • Criação de APIs RESTful;
  • Controle de versionamento com Git;
  • Arquitetura baseada em microsserviços.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Vivência com mensagerias (Kafka, RabbitMQ);
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Desenvolvimento orientado a testes (TDD, BDD);
  • Criação de testes de integração e de carga;
  • Utilização de containers (Docker);
  • Orquestração com Kubernetes;
  • Banco de dados NoSQL (MongoDB);
  • Uso de cache (Redis);
  • Vivência com atuação em times ágeis e em ambientes de alta disponibilidade.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer

What you’ll do

  • Design, develop, and optimize data pipelines and distributed data systems
  • Build and maintain ETL workflows across multiple systems
  • Lead analytics modules and communicate technical outcomes clearly
  • Partner with consulting teams to define delivery outcomes and technical approach
  • Deliver production-ready solutions (from prototype to enterprise-grade systems)


Technical Requirements – Required

  • Python and SQL
  • Relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or similar)
  • NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis, Neo4j or similar)
  • Distributed systems (Spark / PySpark / Hadoop)
  • Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)


Nice to Have

  • Airflow, Data Factory, Glue, Prefect, Dagster
  • Snowflake / Star schema modeling
  • Kafka / streaming frameworks
  • Docker / Kubernetes
  • Azure Data Lake Storage
  • Data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)

title: Desenvolvedor .Net
description:
We are looking for a seasoned Full Stack or Frontend-focused developer with strong .NET and C# expertise to join a globally distributed team. The ideal candidate bridges legacy system maintenance with modern platform evolution, delivering robust, secure, and scalable solutions in an international insurance environment.


Mandatory Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience (full stack or frontend-focused);
  • Strong command of .NET / C# development;
  • Proven experience maintaining legacy .NET Framework applications alongside modernization work in .NET Core / .NET;
  • Proficiency with React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3;
  • Experience designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs, including API integrations;
  • Hands-on experience with Kendo UI for component-rich frontend development;
  • Experience building cross-platform applications with .NET MAUI;
  • Working knowledge of relational databases (SQL Server preferred).
  • Security & Identity: OAuth 2.0, JWT, and other identity/authentication frameworks;
  • Architecture & Patterns: MVC, MVVM, layered architecture, microservices.


Language Requirements

  • Fluent in English — written and verbal
  • Fluent in Spanish — written and verbal


Nice to Have

  • Microsoft Power Platform : hands-on familiarity with Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI;
  • Azure & DevOps: Azure services — web apps, API hosting, and DevOps pipelines and Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks experience;
  • Security & Compliance: Secure coding practices, identity management, and data protection (critical for the international insurance context);
  • Industry Experience: Background in healthcare or insurance industries is a strong plus.


Location : Home Office

PJ Contract - Salary: Negotiable

Start Availability : Immediate

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

  • Please prioritize senior-level Data/MLOps Engineers with strong coding ability and clear communication. Candidates must be able to clearly explain their approach, design decisions, trade offs, and alternatives, and articulate end-to-end MLOps architecture. Candidates with average coding skills or limited ability to communicate ideas will not be considered.


Data Engineer (MLOps Focus)Team & Scope

  • The team owns the entire data pipeline , from ingestion to downstream consumption.
  • Data Engineering and MLOps responsibilities are combined , and the team supports multiple projects simultaneously.
  • This is primarily a Data Engineering role , with strong exposure to MLOps and ML integration .

Technical Focus

  • The team writes significantly less SQL compared to a typical Data Engineering team.
  • There is a large Business Analyst team responsible for providing raw data and writing most of the SQL.
  • Candidates must be comfortable with SQL , but in day to day work, SQL usage is limited.
  • Strong programming and system design skills are critical, similar to a traditional Software Engineering role.
  • Python is the main programming language, but strong experience in Java or Scala is also acceptable.
  • The ideal profile is a generalist , not a specialist.
  • Key expectations include:
  • Writing production grade code
  • Designing scalable systems
  • Orchestrating end to end data and ML pipelines
  • Integrating ML models into broader systems
  • SQL is considered an additional skill , not the core focus.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance full stack applications with a strong emphasis on backend architecture.
  • Lead and contribute to the integration of AI/ML features into products, collaborating closely with data scientists and engineers.
  • Develop robust backend services and APIs using Python or Node.js (Express, NestJS) .
  • Contribute to frontend development using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript practices.
  • Identify, prioritize, and execute tasks throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Debug, optimize, and maintain backend systems, APIs, and data workflows.
  • Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, and best engineering practices.
  • Document development phases, monitor system performance, and improve reliability.
  • Participate in Scrum meetings and contribute to product and technical decision-making.


Qualifications

  • Higher education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and/or Machine Learning
  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with strong backend expertise in Python and/or Node.js.
  • Proficiency with frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments.
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as MySQL, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL.
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, Agile development principles, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Interest in applied AI and automation-driven development.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

We only accept CVs that are in English.


Flatiron has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, color, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be disregarded.

title: Data Software Engineer (US/UK International Projects)
description:
Software Engineer - Data Platform (International Client)

Location: Florianópolis, Brazil | Hybrid

Language: English (daily use with US/UK clients)


About the Opportunity

Join our consultancy team and work directly with a leading insurance company in the US/UK, building their complete data platform from the ground up. This is your chance to bring world-class, AI augmented software engineering practices to a greenfield data engineering project while collaborating daily with international teams.


What You'll Do

  • Design and build a robust data platform for a major insurance company
  • Orchestrate AI agents to research, plan and implement complex data pipelines while demonstrating to the wider team how to leverage these tools to increase velocity and quality.
  • Bring solid software engineering principles to data engineering challenges
  • Work embedded within the client's team, driving technical excellence
  • Collaborate in English with distributed teams across the US and UK


What We're Looking For

Must Have:

  • Excellent communication skills in English - you'll be working daily with international clients
  • Strong software engineering mindset - clean code, testing, reliability, and maintainability are in your DNA
  • Deep understanding of relational databases and large-scale data systems
  • Full AI-Augmented Development - you're already using AI agents and modern dev tools


You'll Thrive Here If:

  • You want international exposure while staying in Brazil
  • You value engineering excellence over quick fixes
  • You're excited about hybrid work (office + remote flexibility in Floripa)
  • You see data engineering as a software engineering discipline


About Us

We're a Florianópolis-based software development and consultancy company working with clients in the US and UK. We believe in combining the best of Brazilian tech talent with international opportunities.


Ready to level up your career with international experience? Let's talk.

title: Senior Magento Developer (Magento 2 / Performance Focus)
description:
Senior Magento Developer (Magento 2 / Performance Focus) | Remote


QAT Global, a QAT Global US-based IT consulting firm with more than 30 years in the market, is hiring a Senior Magento Developer in Brazil to join an international project supporting a US client.

This professional will work directly with client stakeholders in the US and collaborate with distributed teams across Brazil, Costa Rica, and the United States, contributing to performance improvements, technical analysis, and long-term platform stability in a complex Magento environment.


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Hiring Model: CLT only


Main Challenges:


  • Analyze and improve performance across the Magento platform, identifying backend, database, and front-end bottlenecks
  • Review legacy customizations and refactor technical debt impacting platform efficiency
  • Optimize JavaScript execution and storefront rendering performance
  • Evaluate modules, extensions, and integrations according to Magento best practices
  • Support code deployment and version control using GitHub and CI/CD workflows
  • Investigate root causes of production issues and propose scalable technical solutions
  • Contribute with architectural recommendations focused on scalability, maintainability, and security


Required Experience:


  • Strong professional experience with Magento development (Magento 2 strongly preferred)
  • Strong expertise in Magento architecture, module development, and customizations
  • Proven experience troubleshooting performance issues and legacy code problems
  • Solid knowledge of JavaScript performance optimization in Magento storefronts
  • Strong experience with PHP, HTML5, CSS, and codebase improvement
  • Experience with repository management and deployment workflows using GitHub
  • Ability to work directly with technical teams and client stakeholders in English


Preferred Background:


  • Magento caching and database optimization
  • CI/CD and DevOps practices
  • Code audits and technical health assessments
  • Large-scale e-commerce environments


This role is particularly relevant for professionals who have already worked with complex Magento environments, production troubleshooting, and technical modernization of existing platforms.

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Position Summary:

We are seeking friendly and motivated Customer Support Specialists to serve our

customers and restaurant owners by providing assistance regarding account management

or order inquiries. This could include changes to their account, minor updates to their

menu, or inquiries about an order


Essential Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Take inbound calls from either the customer or the restaurant.
  • Make outbound calls to customers or restaurants to follow up on acknowledgement errors.
  • Manage incoming tickets generated from email or text via CRM (customer relationship management portal).
  • Return calls for any voicemails that a ticket is generated for Minor troubleshooting product or service problems reported by the customer or the restaurant.
  • Route calls / tickets to appropriate channels if necessary.
  • Facilitate and document accurate correspondence between the restaurant and customers
  • Miscellaneous clerical duties.


Education:

  • Minimum – High school diploma (or Equivalent)


Experience:

  • 6+ months work experience (Internship acceptable)
  • Fluent in English - Bilingual Spanish/English preferred
  • Must be available for evening and weekend shifts
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong critical thinking / problem solving skills
  • Preferred but not required:
  • Previous call center experience
  • Food Industry experience


What You Need For This Position:

  • Be flexible with working schedules, including nights and weekends
  • Efficient in operating a computer in a Windows based environment
  • Possess strong verbal and written communication skills in the English language
  • Communicate effectively in the English language
  • Have strong interpersonal skills, problem solving skills and negotiating skills
  • Think analytically
  • Work in a fast-paced environment
  • Be organized and have strong time management skills

title: Engenheiro Orçamentista
description:
Atividades:

Desenvolvimento e estudo das diversas etapas para a elaboração de Propostas Técnicas e Comerciais para clientes de Infraestrutura, assim como apoio às obras em andamento:


Leitura análise dos projetos;

Consultas ao mercado de fornecedores;

Planejamento das obras em estudo;

Orçamento do custo direto em softwares da área;

Desenvolvimento do custo indireto

Análise das condições de fechamento e impostos.

Elaboração de Planejamento de Obra.


Outros requisitos


Ter experiência como Engenheiro Orçamentista em obra de construção pesada, principalmente obras de infraestrutura na área mineração (barragem, diques, etc), rodoviárias, ferroviárias, e Obras de arte correntes, pontes e viadutos.

Conhecimento em Softwares de Orçamentos (Compor 90, RM, etc) e Planejamento de Obras (Project, Primavera e afins);

Superior completo em Engenharia Civil ou Produção.

Pós-graduação na área de Engenharia de Custos (desejável);

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Tech Lead JavaScript FullStack Developer
description:
Tech Lead JavaScript FullStack Developer

Brazil

Software Engineer Lead

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As the Tech Lead for our JavaScript/TypeScript full‑stack team, you will guide technical direction, drive architectural decisions, and serve as a key technical counterpart to our client stakeholders. You’ll be a great contributor to the code quality and security aspects, while actively coaching engineers to deepen the team’s expertise in our core stack. You’ll be hands-on and equally strong in communication—facilitating technical discussions, translating business needs into technical plans, and ensuring we commit secure, scalable, and high‑quality solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • As a technical lead, be a reference when communicating with the team and stakeholders (including the client);
  • Raise and discuss trade-offs of different design approaches elaborating detailed design documents;
  • Development of new features;
  • Maintenance of existing applications;
  • Help define and document practices, methodologies and processes relevant to technical teams, improving Encora’s knowledge base;
  • Implement solution from coding to testing to production deployment support;
  • Mentor less experienced team members.

Essential Skills


  • Broad experience with full stack development based in JavaScript;
  • Experience with analysis, design, and implementation;
  • Experience NextJS and NodeJS;
  • Cloud knowledge (specially AWS Lambda, AWS CDK and serverless).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Knowledge about agile software development;
  • Experience in driving Scrum rituals (Planning, Daily, Review and Retrospective).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Engenheiro de Dados (Databricks)
description:
Curte trabalhar com dados em escala e enfrentar desafios reais de migração e transformação?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados para atuar em um projeto estratégico de migração de dados de Oracle para Databricks.

Aqui, você terá um papel central na construção de pipelines robustos e escaláveis, garantindo qualidade, performance e governança das informações em ambiente cloud — com impacto direto no negócio e proximidade com o cliente.

Responsabilidades

Participar ativamente do processo de migração de dados de Oracle para a plataforma Databricks

Desenvolver e manter pipelines utilizando PySpark (Spark + Python) e SQL

Trabalhar com notebooks (ex.: Jupyter) para exploração e transformação de dados

Colaborar com times multidisciplinares, incluindo contato direto e frequente com o cliente, para entendimento de requisitos e alinhamento de entregas

Garantir a integridade e consistência dos dados ao longo do processo de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização


Requisitos

Experiência comprovada com PySpark, SQL e Databricks

Experiência com Databricks em projetos de dados

Experiência em projetos de alta complexidade e alta volumetria de dados

Conhecimentos em ambientes de Big Data e boas práticas em engenharia de dados

Vivência com notebooks (Jupyter ou similares)

Habilidade de comunicação e boa capacidade de relacionamento interpessoal

Perfil proativo, organizado e orientado a entregas

⭐ Diferenciais

Experiência anterior em projetos de migração de dados

Familiaridade com ambientes cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP)

title: Quality Assurance (QA) — Funcional / Manual
description:
Estamos buscando profissionais de QA para atuação em qualidade ponta a ponta, com foco em validação funcional, evidências e rastreabilidade das entregas em um ecossistema com microserviços, integrações e múltiplos meios de pagamento.


Junte-se a um time orientado à inovação, focado em excelência de automação e qualidade, sob a liderança de um Coordenador de Engenharia de QA experiente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Planejar, executar e evidenciar testes funcionais ponta a ponta, garantindo aderência às regras de negócio.
  • Criar e manter cenários/casos de teste e evidências com rastreabilidade em Jira/Xray (preferencialmente com Gherkin quando aplicável).
  • Participar de refinamentos, entendimento de regras e definição de critérios de aceite.
  • Executar testes de regressão, testes exploratórios e suporte a UAT/homologação.
  • Validar integrações e fluxos críticos envolvendo APIs, microserviços, mensageria (SQS), ERP e meios de pagamento (Pix/Boleto/Cartão).
  • Acompanhar incidentes/bugs, priorização e retestes junto aos times de desenvolvimento e produto.
  • Garantir rastreabilidade entre requisito ↔ teste ↔ evidência ↔ defeito (Jira/Xray).


Conhecimentos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência com testes funcionais e processos de qualidade em ambientes ágeis.
  • Vivência com sistemas distribuídos e integrações (APIs/microserviços).
  • Capacidade de validar APIs com ferramentas como Postman/Insomnia (validação de payload, status code e regra).
  • Vivência com Jira e ferramenta de gestão de testes (ex.: Xray).
  • Boa escrita de cenários, critérios de aceite e documentação de evidências.
  • Experiência com regressão e priorização de cenários críticos.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Noções de observabilidade (Dynatrace/Loki) para apoio à triagem e evidências.
  • Experiência com jornadas de Checkout e Pagamentos (Pix, boleto, cartão) e fluxos correlatos.
  • Noções de segurança/controles (ex.: PCI) do ponto de vista de testes (cuidados com dados sensíveis e evidências).
  • Conhecimento básico de ambientes cloud/AWS e dinâmica de múltiplos ambientes (multi-account).

Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas ao redor do mundo. Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todas as pessoas e não discriminamos com base em identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, origem nacional, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em qualquer jurisdição onde atuamos.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Java) - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Senior Backend Engineer (Java) position focuses on designing and developing sophisticated, scalable backend systems using Java technologies. This role involves leading technical initiatives, mentoring junior engineers, and creating high-performance, robust solutions that address complex business challenges while implementing microservices architectures and ensuring technical excellence across the team.


Key responsibilities


- Architecting and implementing complex, scalable backend services using Java and related technologies.

- Leading technical design and implementation of enterprise-level software solutions.

- Mentoring junior engineers and contributing to the team's technical excellence and best practices.

- Designing and optimizing database schemas and data access strategies for performance and scalability.

- Implementing microservices architectures and cloud-native applications.
